blocks.text: CABANATUAN CITY — A food delivery rider known for his humorous social media videos was shot dead by an unidentified assailant in Barangay Mayapyap Sur here at 9:40 p.m. on Thursday, Oct. 15, police said. The victim, known online as Ser Bong TV, was wearing a green long-sleeved Grab uniform, blue jeans and a multicolored motorcycle helmet when responding police officers found him dead.
